author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

An `element` that is returned by the `[]-operator` of an SoAView contains SOA_SCALAR as well as SOA_COLUMN and SOA_EIGEN_COLUMN. However, the element returns the SCALAR as `SoAValue` whos access operator does nothing else than `return col[idx_];` and for a SCALAR this means it accesses only a meaningful value for `idx_ == 0`. So allowing access to scalar values through an element is dangerous and will usually lead to unwanted results. This PR removes scalar values from the `const_element` and `element` structs entirely. 


FYI @felicepantaleo
title: Remove SCALARS from SoA elements
